events.title: TRANSMISSION: THE JOVIAN TRITIUM EMBARGO
events.sender: Interstellar Commerce Guild & Outer Colonies Fleet
events.body: Colony skirmish fleets have blockaded Jovian gas siphons, cutting off deep-space Tritium exports. Galactic market spot prices for Plasma-Charged Tritium have surged by +300% (from 1,200 Cr to 3,600 Cr). Commercial refineries are desperate for unrefined reserves.

choices.label: 1. Liquidate Tritium Stockpile
choices.desc: Sell 5x Tritium on the open exchange for massive immediate liquidity (+18,000 Cr).

choices.label: 2. Hoard Reserves for PMC R&D
choices.desc: Keep all Tritium secured for proprietary Hyperion fusion core synthesis.

choices.label: 3. Deploy Blockade Runner Escort
choices.desc: Deploy PMC aces to escort Colony tankers. Boosts Colony standing (+25) but risks Terran sanctions.

events.title: URGENT DISPATCH: MINING CORPS HAZARD STRIKE
events.sender: Iron Ridge PMC Pilots & Rigger Union
events.body: Following heavy pirate skirmishes across Asteroid Belt C-14, mining riggers and deployed escort pilots are refusing sorties without an immediate emergency combat stipend. Morale is deteriorating rapidly.

choices.label: 1. Approve Combat Bonus (-45,000 Cr)
choices.desc: Pay the emergency hazard bonus. Restores pilot morale (+20%) and increases extraction yield.

choices.label: 2. Enforce Mercenary Guild Protocol
choices.desc: Refuse demands. Pilots stay on standard contracts. Morale drops (-15%), risk of desertion.

events.title: CLASSIFIED INTERCEPT: SYNDICATE BLACK MARKET LEAK
events.body: Terran security forces seized a Syndicate smuggler barge carrying stripped GHA-07 Ironclad ordnance. Forensic serial stamps trace back to an unlogged sale from your manufacturing bays. Terran inspectors demand answers.

choices.label: 1. Bribe Chief Inspector (-60,000 Cr)
choices.desc: Quietly transfer funds to classify the dossier as pirate salvage. Avoids faction sanctions.

choices.label: 2. Claim Corporate Theft & Scapegoat
choices.desc: Blame rogue smugglers. Standing with Terran Coalition drops (-25), but retains funds.

events.title: PERSONNEL DOSSIER: VETERAN ACE FOR HIRE
events.body: Former Coalition frontline ace Captain Victor 'Ronin' Drake is seeking a PMC contract after refusing questionable orbital bombardment orders. Highly proficient in 120mm solid-slug cannons and hydraulic melee breaching.

choices.label: 1. Hire Captain Drake (-75,000 Cr Signing Bonus)
choices.desc: Recruit top-tier ace (92% Accuracy, 84% Reflexes). Daily salary: 340 Cr.

choices.label: 2. Pass on Candidate

events.title: CLASSIFIED DISPATCH: CORPORATE PROTOTYPE LEAK
events.body: Commander, our moles inside Astraea Orbital Dynamics have intercepted encrypted CAD schematics of their next-generation micro-gravity frame. They plan to submit this prototype in the upcoming Colony procurement tender. The broker is asking 60,000 Credits for the decrypted telemetry.

choices.label: 1. Purchase CAD Schematics (-60,000 Cr)
choices.consequence_desc: Telemetry decrypted! Next procurement fly-off against Astraea gains a +10 PTS competitive insight bonus.

choices.label: 2. Leak Encrypted Data to Terran Military Intelligence
choices.consequence_desc: Terran Coalition awards a 45,000 Cr finder's fee (+15 Terran Standing, -10 Colony Standing).

choices.label: 3. Disregard Intercept as Corporate Counter-Intel
choices.consequence_desc: Transmission archived without action.

events.title: EMERGENCY TENDER: LUNAR DEFENSE CRISIS
events.body: Urgent alert, mercenary. Syndicate pirate wolves have breached the perimeter at Archimedes Crater. The Terran Coalition has issued an emergency 3-turn flash tender for combat-ready heavy linebreakers. Any approved prototype will bypass standard shipyard tooling delays with a 50% licensing bounty bonus!

choices.label: 1. Mobilize Foundry for Emergency Mass-Production
choices.consequence_desc: Emergency defense contract ratified! +250,000 Cr mobilization grant awarded and Terran standing surged.

choices.label: 2. Deploy PMC Strike Squad to Hold the Crater Lines
choices.consequence_desc: PMC aces deployed to Lunar lines. Frontline held (+120,000 Cr combat bonus, +25 Terran Standing, +PMC Combat Pedigree).

choices.label: 3. Prioritize Existing Foundry Orders
choices.consequence_desc: Declined flash tender (-5 Terran Standing).

events.title: MARKET SHOCK: VALKYRIE HEAVY HYDRAULIC COLLAPSE
events.body: Catastrophe in the Jovian trenches! Valkyrie Heavy Industries' newly deployed GHA-07 line units have suffered widespread joint seizing in deep-frost mud, stranding two mechanized divisions. Terran High Command is furious and corporate stock has plunged 22%. The Munitions Board is openly considering canceling their contract.

choices.label: 1. Launch Aggressive Replacement Tender Blitz (-50,000 Cr)
choices.consequence_desc: PR blitz launched! Siphoned 4% Sol market share from Valkyrie Heavy and boosted Terran favor.

choices.label: 2. Offer Foundry Nanite Repair Kits at Extortionate Rates
choices.consequence_desc: Terran emergency procurement purchases foundry alloy kits for +140,000 Cr profit.

choices.label: 3. Issue Neutral Engineering Advisory
choices.consequence_desc: Neutral technical assistance offered (+5 Terran Standing).

events.title: RADAR ANOMALY: DEFECTOR TEST PILOT INCOMING
events.body: Commander! An experimental mobile suit with transhuman neural avionics has crossed our flight deck without transponder codes. The pilot identifies as Ren 'Null-09', lead test pilot from Hyperion Advanced Tactical Systems, requesting asylum with their tuned Muramasa-X prototype!

choices.label: 1. Grant Asylum: Commission Pilot & Prototype into PMC Hangar
choices.consequence_desc: Elite pilot and prototype accepted into PMC roster! Hyperion corporate hostility increases.

choices.label: 2. Strip Prototype for Exotic Tachyon Alloys & Foundry Data
choices.consequence_desc: Chassis dismantled in Crucible. +180,000 Cr and exotic metallurgy unlocked.

choices.label: 3. Extradite Pilot Back to Hyperion for Diplomatic Bounty
choices.consequence_desc: Extradited to Hyperion (+95,000 Cr bounty, Zaibatsu standing +20).

events.title: DIPLOMATIC CABLE: CLONED CHASSIS PIRATE INCIDENT
events.body: Disaster on the Ganymede shipping route! A pirate battle wing was detected piloting pirated hulls identical to your exported mobile suit blueprint, pillaging an unarmed medical freighter. Planetary press outlets are broadcasting footage with your corporate insignias, demanding an official response.

choices.label: 1. Transmit Firmware Kill-Switch Code to Colony Defense
choices.consequence_desc: Kill-switch transmitted! Pirate units disabled in space (+25 Colony Standing, PR crisis averted).

choices.label: 2. Deploy PMC Strike Lance to Destroy the Pirates Pro Bono
choices.consequence_desc: Pirates eliminated under PMC guns (+50,000 Cr salvage, +20 Colony Standing, +Combat Pedigree).

choices.label: 3. 'Arms Dealers Don't Choose the Battle' (Sell Ammo)
choices.consequence_desc: +65,000 Cr unlogged arms profits (-20 Colony Standing).

events.title: RED ALERT: CORPORATE WET-WORK AMBUSH
events.body: Proximity sensors screaming! A heavily armed black-ops strike team displaying scrubbed corporate serial numbers has breached the outer perimeter of our resource extraction outpost. They have deployed electronic jamming and are attempting to scuttle our mining crucibles!

choices.label: 1. Scramble Hangar Battlegroup to Repel the Raid
choices.consequence_desc: PMC aces scrambled! Corporate hit-squad annihilated (+75,000 Cr bounty salvage, +Combat Pedigree).

choices.label: 2. Activate Overcharged Automated Defense Sentry Turrets
choices.consequence_desc: Sentries fired at maximum overload. Perimeter held with minor facility repair costs (-40,000 Cr).

choices.label: 3. Tactical Withdrawal & Secure Nanite Crucible Cores
choices.consequence_desc: Crucibles secured; minor ore stock lost (-25,000 Cr).

events.title: GLOBAL INTERCEPT: THE PROMETHEUS PROTOCOL SORTIE
events.body: Commander, unencrypted sensor telemetry of our maiden Mobile Suit sortie has leaked across all military frequencies! Frontline footage shows our humanoid machine easily traversing a fractured volcanic ravine, deflecting standard 90mm tank munitions, and tearing the turret off a Terran heavy tank in close-quarters melee. The Sol Defense Board has declared an emergency summit. Every intelligence agency in the solar system is attempting to establish contact with our flagship.

choices.label: 1. Broadcast Open Procurement Availability (+3.0x Bounty Surge)
choices.consequence_desc: All factions acknowledge our PMC as the premier military pioneer. Emergency contract bounties surged across all sectors.

choices.label: 2. Declare Technology Top-Secret & Enforce Comms Blackout
choices.consequence_desc: Maintains total tactical secrecy. Megacorporation reverse-engineering efforts are slowed by 15%.

events.title: DIPLOMATIC SUMMONS: TERRAN COALITION HIGH ADMIRALTY
events.sender: Grand Marshal Donald Sterling (Terran High Command)
events.body: Iron Vanguard. I will dispense with diplomatic pleasantries. We watched your walking metal monstrosity crush our armored platoon in Neo-Verona. Our tank commanders are refusing to deploy unless they have comparable support. The Coalition Munitions Board is offering an immediate 150,000 Credit grant and 100 units of refined Tungsten if you agree to provide an operational chassis for evaluation.

choices.label: 1. Sign Exclusive Technology Evaluation Pact (+150k Cr, +100 Tungsten, Rivals +20% R&D)
choices.consequence_desc: Huge cash injection and rare metal reserves secured! However, Vanguard Heavy Industries accelerates its reverse-engineering clock.

choices.label: 2. Respectfully Decline: Mercenary Sortie Contracts Only
choices.consequence_desc: We retain our tech monopoly while keeping Terran Coalition on retainer as paying contract clients.

events.title: ENCRYPTED BURST: ORBITAL INDEPENDENCE ALLIANCE
events.body: Vanguard Command, your bipedal frame represents more than a military weapon—it is the equalizer that can prevent Earth's dreadnoughts from choking the outer colonies into submission. If Earth manages to reverse-engineer your machine first, our colonies will be bombed back into the stone age. We are pleading for your support. Provide our engineers with reactor schematics, or fight alongside our skimmer wings.

choices.label: 1. Partner with Colony Fleet (+200k Cr, +40 Tritium, +30 Colony Standing)
choices.consequence_desc: Colony freedom fighters hail our Foundry as liberators! Astraea Orbital gains telemetry to develop their agile aerial frames.

choices.label: 2. Offer Escort Contracts Without Tech Transfer
choices.consequence_desc: Agreed to fly-off trials and defensive operations without relinquishing core Tokamak patents.

events.title: SECURITY BREACH: SYNDICATE WET-WORK INFILTRATION
events.body: Commander! Syndicate raiders breached Hangar Bay 3 under cover of an optical jamming flare! They weren't after money—they were trying to download the Tokamak magnetic bottle assembly telemetry from our terminal! Our security team has pinned their operative down in the airlock corridor.

choices.label: 1. Interrogate Operative & Trace Syndicate Backer
choices.consequence_desc: Operative cracked under interrogation. We discovered Rustworks' secret testing facility, reducing their R&D progress by -10%.

choices.label: 2. Execute Operative & Broadcast Warning to Sol Underworld
choices.consequence_desc: Demonstrated ruthless operational defense. Syndicate pirate raids against our mining nodes drop significantly.

events.title: RECON REPORT: RIVAL CORP COMMISSIONS WALKING TESTBED
events.body: Long-range orbital radar has picked up a high-energy seismic disturbance in the Asteroid Belt. One of our rival competitors has completed assembly of a crude bipedal hybrid—a converted heavy tank chassis mounted onto bipedal walking hydraulics. It's primitive, unstable, and prone to overheating, but it proves they are closing the gap. The countdown to full rival Mobile Suit mass production is ticking down.

choices.label: 1. Deploy Precision Strike on Rival Testing Grounds
choices.consequence_desc: Rival testbed annihilated in a precision strike! Competitor reverse-engineering delayed by 40 calendar days.

choices.label: 2. Accelerate Our Next-Generation Sintering R&D
choices.consequence_desc: We double down on superior alloy metallurgy, unlocking advanced Tier-3 composite recipes.
